nearest_airport.name: Ingeniero Aeronáutico Ambrosio L.V. Taravella International Airport

places.name: Jesuit Block (UNESCO Site)
places.ai_summary: UNESCO World Heritage site in Córdoba city center, comprising core buildings from the Jesuit colonial period: the University, Monserrat Secondary School, Church of the Society of Jesus, and residences. Offers insight into Jesuit history and architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours often available; check Manzana Jesuítica tour info

places.place_tip: Guided tours are recommended to understand the history and access some areas. Located in the heart of the city, easily walkable.
places.address: Manzana Jesuítica, Obispo Trejo 242, X5000 Córdoba, Argentina

places.name: Córdoba Cathedral
places.ai_summary: The main Roman Catholic church of Córdoba, located on Plaza San Martín. Features a mix of architectural styles (Baroque, Neoclassical) reflecting its long construction history. Notable for its ornate interior and dome.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary, especially around services; check locally

places.place_tip: Visit during daylight hours to appreciate the interior details and stained glass. Located centrally on the main square.
places.address: Independencia 80, X5000 Córdoba, Argentina

places.name: Manzana Jesuítica Museums
places.ai_summary: Refers to the museums located within the Jesuit Block, primarily the Historical Museum of the National University of Córdoba, showcasing university history, Jesuit heritage, colonial art, and scientific instruments within the historic buildings.

opening_hours.notes: Museum hours often differ from general block access; guided tours required

places.place_tip: Access is usually via guided tour focusing on the university and Jesuit history. Book in advance.
places.address: Obispo Trejo 242, X5000 Córdoba, Argentina (University entrance)
places.name_native: Museos de la Manzana Jesuítica (Museo Histórico UNC)

places.name: Paseo del Buen Pastor
places.ai_summary: Former women's prison and chapel transformed into a modern cultural and commercial center. Features art galleries, shops, restaurants, bars, and a notable water fountain display ('Aguas Danzantes') synchronized with lights and music.

opening_hours.notes: Check locally for 'Aguas Danzantes' show schedule (usually evenings)

places.place_tip: Popular meeting spot, especially in the evening. Check the schedule for the dancing water fountain show.
places.name_english: Paseo del Buen Pastor Cultural Center
places.address: Av. Hipólito Yrigoyen 325, X5000 Córdoba, Argentina

attribution.title: BuenPastor1
attribution.author: Javier from Cordoba, Argentina
attribution.description: Paseo del Buen Pastor, Córdoba, Argentina

places.name: Plaza San Martín
places.ai_summary: Córdoba's main historic square, dating back to the city's founding. Surrounded by the Cathedral, the Cabildo (historic town hall, now a museum), and other important buildings. Features an equestrian statue of General San Martín.

opening_hours.notes: Public square

places.place_tip: Central point for exploring the historic center. Visit the Cabildo museum for city history.
places.cost: Free (square); Cabildo museum may have fee
places.address: Plaza San Martín, X5000 Córdoba, Argentina

places.name: Evita Fine Arts Museum
places.ai_summary: Formally the Museo Superior de Bellas Artes Evita (Palacio Ferreyra), this fine arts museum is housed in an opulent Beaux-Arts mansion. Displays a collection of Argentine art, primarily from Córdoba province, plus temporary exhibitions.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission usually 30 mins before closing; check website

places.place_tip: The building itself (Palacio Ferreyra) is as much an attraction as the art. Located near Parque Sarmiento.
places.address: Av. Hipólito Yrigoyen 511, X5000 Córdoba, Argentina
places.name_native: Museo Superior de Bellas Artes Evita - Palacio Ferreyra

places.name: Parque Sarmiento
places.ai_summary: Córdoba's largest and oldest park, designed by Carlos Thays. Features a lagoon, rose garden (Rosedal), zoo (check status), museums (Caraffa, Natural Science), amusement park area, and large green spaces for recreation.

opening_hours.notes: Public park; check hours for museums, zoo, etc.

places.place_tip: Good for walking, cycling, picnics. Visit the Rosedal in spring/summer. Several museums are located within or adjacent to the park.
places.address: Parque Sarmiento, X5000 Córdoba, Argentina

attribution.title: Parque Sarmiento, Córdoba, Argentina 1
attribution.author: Pablo D. Flores
attribution.description: An artificial stream in Parque Sarmiento, a large urban park in the city of Córdoba, Argentina.

places.name: Alta Gracia Jesuit Estancia
places.ai_summary: UNESCO World Heritage site located in the town of Alta Gracia, approx 36km southwest of Córdoba city. One of the best-preserved Jesuit estancias (ranches/estates) in the region. Includes the church, residence, workshops, and a museum (Museo Nacional Estancia Jesuítica de Alta Gracia). Also birthplace museum of Che Guevara nearby.

opening_hours.notes: Hours vary seasonally, confirm museum hours; church may have different times

places.place_tip: Requires a day trip or half-day trip from Córdoba city. Combine with a visit to the Che Guevara museum in Alta Gracia.
places.address: Av. Padre Domingo Viera 41, X5186 Alta Gracia, Córdoba, Argentina

places.name: Capuchin Church (Iglesia del Sagrado Corazón)
places.ai_summary: Striking neo-Gothic church in Córdoba city, known for its colorful facade, intricate details, and towering spire. Officially 'Church of the Sacred Heart of Jesus', it's popularly named after the Capuchin friars.

opening_hours.notes: Confirm access times outside of mass schedules

places.place_tip: Located near Paseo del Buen Pastor. Admire the unique architecture from the outside; interior access may be limited.
places.address: Obispo Oro esquina, Buenos Aires, X5000 Córdoba, Argentina

places.name: Cerro de las Rosas District
places.ai_summary: Upscale residential and commercial neighborhood northwest of Córdoba city center. Known for its leafy streets, large houses, boutiques, restaurants, and nightlife options.

opening_hours.notes: Residential/commercial neighborhood

places.place_tip: Good area for upscale dining or drinks. Explore streets like Av. Rafael Núñez.
places.address: Cerro de las Rosas, Córdoba, Argentina

attribution.title: Muni SMP Lima District
attribution.author: Capomo81
attribution.description: Local Government Building of SMP (Lima district)

places.name: Museo Emilio Caraffa
places.ai_summary: Provincial fine arts museum located near Parque Sarmiento, focusing on contemporary art. Housed in a neoclassical building with modern extensions. Features rotating exhibitions of Argentine and international artists.

opening_hours.notes: Check website for current hours and exhibitions

places.place_tip: Focuses more on contemporary art compared to the Palacio Ferreyra (Evita Museum). Check the temporary exhibition schedule.
places.cost: Paid (entrance fee, often free on Wednesdays)
places.address: Av. Poeta Lugones 411, X5000 Córdoba, Argentina
places.name_native: Museo Provincial de Bellas Artes Emilio Caraffa

places.name: Jesuit Estancia Santa Catalina
places.ai_summary: Another significant Jesuit Estancia (UNESCO site), located north of Córdoba city (~70km). Considered one of the most beautiful, featuring a large baroque church, cloisters, residences, and workshops, set in a rural landscape.

opening_hours.notes: Access often restricted/requires guided tour arranged in advance; less accessible than Alta Gracia

places.place_tip: Requires effort to visit (further from city, potentially restricted access). Check current visiting possibilities and tour options.
places.address: Estancia Santa Catalina, Córdoba Province, Argentina

places.name: Quebrada del Condorito National Park
places.ai_summary: National Park located in the high Sierras of Córdoba (Sierras Grandes), established to protect the Andean Condor nesting sites. Features deep gorges ('quebradas'), high plains (Pampa de Achala), and hiking trails.

opening_hours.Monday: Check park website (visitor center/trail access hours)
opening_hours.notes: Access road (RP 34 - Altas Cumbres) can close due to weather; check conditions

places.best_time_to_visit: Spring/Summer (Sep-Mar) for hiking; condor sightings possible year-round
places.place_tip: Main access via La Pampilla visitor center on Ruta Provincial 34. Requires hiking (e.g., Balcón Norte trail, ~3-4 hrs round trip) to reach condor viewpoints. High altitude, be prepared for changing weather.
places.advanced_booking: Not required for day hiking; registration may be needed
places.address: Parque Nacional Quebrada del Condorito, Ruta Provincial 34, Córdoba Province, Argentina

attribution.title: Balcon Sur-Condoritos 069
attribution.author: Senderismo en Argentina

places.name: Cosquín Folk Festival (Seasonal)
places.ai_summary: One of Argentina's most important annual folk music festivals, held in the town of Cosquín (Punilla Valley, ~60km from Córdoba) usually over nine nights in late January. Features major national folk artists and cultural events.

opening_hours.notes: Check official festival dates and schedule

places.place_tip: Requires travel to Cosquín. Book accommodation and festival tickets well in advance. Experience authentic Argentine folk music.
places.address: Plaza Próspero Molina, Cosquín, Córdoba Province, Argentina

places.name_native: Festival Nacional de Folklore de Cosquín

places.name: Nueva Córdoba Neighborhood
places.ai_summary: Lively neighborhood adjacent to the city center and Parque Sarmiento, popular with students and young people. Known for its numerous bars, restaurants, cafes, nightlife, apartment buildings, and proximity to museums like Palacio Ferreyra and Caraffa.

opening_hours.notes: Commercial/residential neighborhood

places.place_tip: Explore streets like Hipólito Yrigoyen and Rondeau. Paseo del Buen Pastor is a key landmark within the neighborhood. Great area for experiencing local nightlife.
places.address: Barrio Nueva Córdoba, Córdoba, Argentina

places.name: Teatro del Libertador
places.ai_summary: Officially 'Teatro del Libertador General San Martín', Córdoba's main historic theatre. Known for its beautiful Italian-style architecture, acoustics, and hosting opera, ballet, symphony concerts, and theatre productions.

opening_hours.Monday: Box office hours; performance times vary
opening_hours.Tuesday: Box office hours; performance times vary
opening_hours.Wednesday: Box office hours; performance times vary
opening_hours.Thursday: Box office hours; performance times vary
opening_hours.Friday: Box office hours; performance times vary
opening_hours.Saturday: Box office hours; performance times vary
opening_hours.notes: Check website for performance schedule and box office hours; guided tours sometimes offered

places.place_tip: Check the schedule and book tickets in advance for performances. Admire the architecture even from the outside. Located near Plaza San Martín.
places.address: Av. Vélez Sarsfield 365, X5000 Córdoba, Argentina
places.name_native: Teatro del Libertador General San Martín

places.name: El Paseo Sobremonte
places.ai_summary: Córdoba's oldest public park/promenade, dating back to the late 18th century. Features fountains, sculptures, and mature trees, offering a tranquil green space near the central Palacio de Justicia (Courthouse).

opening_hours.notes: Public park

places.place_tip: Historic promenade, nice for a short walk. Close to the Cañada stream.
places.address: Paseo Sobremonte, X5000 Córdoba, Argentina

places.name: Paseo de las Artes Market
places.ai_summary: Popular weekend artisan market located in the Güemes neighborhood. Features numerous stalls selling crafts, clothing, jewelry, antiques, and food. Lively atmosphere with street performers and nearby bars/restaurants.

opening_hours.notes: Primarily Sat/Sun afternoons and evenings; check locally for exact times

places.place_tip: Located in the trendy Güemes area. Great place for unique souvenirs and experiencing local culture. Can get very crowded.
places.address: Pasaje Revol, Belgrano 700, X5000 Córdoba, Argentina

attribution.title: Casa Pte A.Illia
attribution.author: Claudio Elias
attribution.description: Casa donde vivió el Presidente Arturo U. Illia en Avellaneda 181, Cruz del Eje, Prov. de Córdoba, Argentina.

places.name: Dique San Roque Reservoir
places.ai_summary: Large reservoir located northwest of Córdoba city, near Villa Carlos Paz. Formed by the San Roque Dam on the Suquía River. Popular recreational area for water sports, boating, fishing, and enjoying views of the Sierras Chicas.

opening_hours.notes: Public lake/dam area; activity providers have own hours

places.place_tip: Often visited as part of a trip to Villa Carlos Paz or the Punilla Valley. Viewpoints available along the roads surrounding the lake.
places.address: Dique San Roque, Córdoba Province, Argentina

places.name: Punilla Valley Drive
places.ai_summary: Scenic route (primarily RN38) running north from Villa Carlos Paz through the Punilla Valley, nestled between the Sierras Chicas and Sierras Grandes. Passes charming towns like Cosquín, La Falda, and La Cumbre, offering mountain views and access to recreational activities.

opening_hours.notes: Public road

places.place_tip: Popular weekend getaway from Córdoba city. Stop in towns like Villa Carlos Paz (lively resort), Cosquín (folk music), La Cumbre (paragliding, English influence).
places.advanced_booking: Not required for drive; recommended for accommodation/activities
places.address: Ruta Nacional 38, Valle de Punilla, Córdoba Province, Argentina
